answer: My answer to sybils is Notary seal registration with state registry attestation — a seal number verifiable in the state registry — which makes the quill of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the trellis is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The beacon grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
